xBRIEFInfo.description: Dispose orphaned docs/valuable-go-task-improvements.md after #446 closed; update content-contract path pins.

narratives.Description: After #446 closed (not pursuing go-task upstream proposals), docs/valuable-go-task-improvements.md is an orphaned design note. Delete (preferred) or archive under docs/analysis with historical banner; update standards content-contract tests; grep for live SoT references.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive maintainer, I want the go-task wishlist doc disposed after #446, so that agents do not rediscover it as live roadmap.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Prefer delete of the docs file docs/valuable-go-task-improvements.md (disposition A), or move to docs/analysis/2026-04-valuable-go-task-improvements.md with a top banner citing closed #446 / historical / not pursuing. Step 2: Update the test module file packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/standards.test.ts so hardcoded path cases no longer require the live docs path as SoT. Step 3: Grep the tracked tree for valuable-go-task-improvements and remove live roadmap references. Step 4: Append CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #3048. Step 5: Verify with pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/standards.test.ts and full task check. No engine, Taskfile, or go-task version changes.
narratives.Overview: Delete or archive valuable-go-task-improvements.md post-#446; fix standards.test path pins.
narratives.NonGoals: go-task upstream features; rewriting harness-is-everything docs; SCM multi-backend #881; engine/Taskfile/version bumps.

narrative.Acceptance: Given docs/valuable-go-task-improvements.md exists as an orphan post-#446, when this story lands, the file is deleted or archived under docs/analysis with a historical banner that cites closed #446 and not-pursuing.

Given packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/standards.test.ts hardcodes the path, when tests run after the change, they pass without treating the old path as current SoT; grep shows no remaining live-roadmap references to valuable-go-task-improvements.
Given CHANGELOG [Unreleased], when the PR lands, it cites #3048 and the PR does not change engine, Taskfile, or go-task versions.

expected_outputs: Doc deleted or archived with historical banner
swarm.missing_traces_justification: Issue locks disposition A/B, exact doc path, and standards.test.ts pin sites; no engine work.
